name: Notoceratops
isnote: Originally a ceratopsian, but the lost fragmentary holotype prevents confident placement; some researchers suggest a hadrosaur (cited Wikipedia revision).
sum: Notoceratops is a doubtful ornithischian from the Maastrichtian of Argentina, once considered a ceratopsian, based on a lost jaw fragment.
holotype: Lost fragmentary specimen found by Augusto Tapia in 1918 — Lago Colhué Huapi Formation, Chubut, Argentina.
biology: Not inferable from the lost holotype.
author: Tapia 1919

images.artist: The original uploader was Ghedo at Italian Wikipedia .
